items.title: Is This Forest Fake?

question.text: Is this forest ancient wilderness, or did people make it?

choices.response: It looks old. Look at who planted it.

items.reveal: This forest was planned and planted. Trees were given from around Japan.
items.notes: Confirm planting dates and the donated-trees claim before live.

items.title: Two Japans
items.task: Take one photo of old or sacred Japan, and one of modern or pop Japan.
items.notes: Engine currently stores one photo. Second photo may wait until a pair field exists.
